findings.description: When the target already exists, the function returns early without removing the temp file in incoming/. Every duplicate upload leaves a full-size orphan file in the incoming directory, so disk usage grows without bound. The old code wrote nothing in this case.
findings.suggestion: Call incoming.unlink(missing_ok=True) before returning in the target.exists() branch. Also unlink the temp file if mkdir or os.replace raises, for example with try/finally.
findings.title: Temp upload file leaked when blob already exists

findings.description: The cleanup try/except covers only the write phase. If _path_for, target.parent.mkdir or os.replace raises, for example on a permission error or a full disk, the temp file in incoming/ stays behind.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the post-write steps in try/except or try/finally that unlinks the temp file on failure.
findings.title: Temp file leaked if mkdir or replace fails after the write
